definition: כַּרְמִיל noun [masculine] crimson, carmine , i.e. crimson stuff, cloth; late (probably Persian loan-word, and a derive. from Persian worm , see De ZDuth. Th. 1878, 593 ); — only 2Chr 2:6 ; 2Chr 2:13 ; 2Chr 3:14 (in all + אַרְגָּמָן (ו־ָןׅ תְּכֵלֶת 2Chr 2:13 ; 2Chr 3:14 + בּוּץ also ); read perhaps also for כַּדְמֶל Song 7:6 (|| אַרְגָּוָן : so Gi , of hair formed spirally, like shell-fish; Gr , of glossy hair).
